examples.text: na h'eva saccāni bahūni nānā, aññatra saññāya niccāni loke, takkañ'ca diṭṭhīsu pakappayitvā, saccaṃ musā'ti dvayadhammam'āhu.
so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā dvayena vūpakāsena sampādeti, kāyavūpakāsena ca cittavūpakāsena ca.

34301.meaning1: duality; two things; pair; couple; dyad

examples.text: dvayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca viññāṇaṃ sambhoti. kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, dvayaṃ paṭicca viññāṇaṃ sambhoti? cakkhuñ'ca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ.
yadā dvayesu dhammesu, pāragū hoti brāhmaṇo, ath'assa sabbe saṃyogā, atthaṃ gacchanti jānato.

34302.commentary: (DNa) dvayakārī'ti kālena kusalaṃ karoti, kālena akusalan'ti evaṃ ubhayakārī.

examples.text: khattiyo'pi kho, vāseṭṭha, kāyena dvayakārī, vācāya dvayakārī, manasā dvayakārī, vimissadiṭṭhiko vimissadiṭṭhikammasamādāno vimissadiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sukhadukkhappaṭisaṃvedī hoti.

34304.meaning2: involving a double meaning or falsehood
34304.commentary: (DNa) dvayagāminī'ti sarūpena atthibhāvaṃ, atthena n'atthibhāvan'ti evaṃ dvayagāminī. alika-tuccha-nipphala-vācāya etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. (DNt) dvayaṃ gacchatī'ti dvayagāminī. kīdisaṃ dvayan'ti āha sarūpenā'ti-ādi.

examples.text: api nu, sunakkhatta, tathāgato taṃ vācaṃ bhāseyya yā sā vācā dvayagāminī'ti?
kā upanisā savanāyā'ti iti ce, bhikkhave, pucchitāro assu, te evam'assu vacanīyā, yāva'd'eva dvayatānaṃ dhammānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇāyā'ti. kiñ'ca dvayataṃ vadetha?

34306.meaning1: observing duality; contemplating dichotomy; seeing of two aspects

examples.text: siyā aññena'pi pariyāyena sammā dvayat'ānupassanā'ti, iti ce, bhikkhave, pucchitāro assu, siyā'ti'ssu vacanīyā.

34308.meaning1: observing the duality; contemplating the dichotomy; seeing two aspects

examples.text: evaṃ sammā dvayat'ānupassino kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno appamattassa ātāpino pahit'attassa viharato dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, diṭṭh'eva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā'ti.

34309.meaning1: dependent on a duality; attached to two things

examples.text: dvayanissito khv'āyaṃ, kaccāna, loko yebhuyyena, atthitañ'c'eva n'atthitañ'ca.

34311.meaning1: meeting of two people; encounter of couples

examples.text: methunadhammo nāma yo so asaddhammo gāmadhammo vasaladhammo duṭṭhullaṃ odak'antikaṃ rahassaṃ dvayaṃdvayasamāpatti, eso methunadhammo nāma.
idha, brāhmaṇa, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā sammā brahmacārī paṭijānamāno na h'eva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayaṃdvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati

34312.meaning1: enjoying coupling; taking pleasure in pairing

34313.grammar: ind, adv, isntr sg of dvaya
34313.meaning1: in two ways; in two parts
34313.meaning2: in two ways; as of two kinds

examples.text: santi, bhante, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā dvayena oghassa nittharaṇaṃ paññapenti, sīlavisuddhihetu ca tapojigucchāhetu ca. idha, bhante, bhagavā kim'āhā'ti?

34314.meaning1: with bad qualities; with negative characteristics
34314.commentary: (PM) svākāre dvākāre'ti saddho puggalo svākāro, assaddho puggalo dvākāro. āraddhavīriyo puggalo svākāro, kusīto puggalo dvākāro. upaṭṭhitassati puggalo svākāro, muṭṭhassati puggalo dvākāro. samāhito puggalo svākāro, asamāhito puggalo dvākāro. paññavā puggalo svākāro, duppañño puggalo dvākāro.

examples.text: addasaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento satte apparaj'akkhe mahāraj'akkhe, tikkh'indriye mud'indriye, svākāre dvākāre, suviññāpaye duviññāpaye, app'ekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante, app'ekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante.

34316.meaning1: badly taught; poorly preached; badly explained

examples.text: evam'eva kho, mahānāma, idha dhammo dvākkhāto hoti duppavedito aniyyāniko anupasamasaṃvattaniko asammāsambuddhappavedito, idam'ahaṃ dukkhettasmiṃ vadāmi.

34317.meaning1: ascetic who subsists on food from only two houses
34317.commentary: (DNa) ek'āgāriko'ti yo ekasmiṃ'y'eva gehe bhikkhaṃ labhitvā nivattati… dv'āgārik'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: te ek'āgārikā vā honti ek'ālopikā, dv'āgārikā vā honti dv'ālopikā… satt'āgārikā vā honti satt'ālopikā. ekissā'pi dattiyā yāpenti, dvīhi'pi dattīhi yāpenti… sattahi'pi dattīhi yāpenti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā. tān'assu kukkuṭiyā na sammā adhisayitāni, na sammā pariseditāni, na sammā paribhāvitāni.
saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ satt'antarā
so'haṃ tato cavitvā, govāṇijakassa gāviyā jāto, vaccho lākhātambo, nillacchito dvādase māse.

34322.construction:
dvi > dva > dvā + dasa + *a + ka + ī
dvādasaka + ī

examples.text: cha pācīnato ninnā, cha ninnā ca samuddato, ete dve cha dvādasa honti, vaggo tena pavuccatī'ti, gaṅgāpeyyālī pācīnaninna-vācanamaggī, vivekanissitaṃ dvādasakī paṭhamakī.

34323.construction:
dvi > dva > dvā + dasa + *a + ka
dvādasa + ka
34323.commentary: (JAa) so pan'esa sattapadena hoti, ekato sattapada-vītihāragamanamattena hotī'ti attho. sahāyo pana dvādasakena hotī'ti sabbakiccāni ekato karaṇavasena sabb'iriyāpathesu saha gacchatī'ti sahāyo. so pan'esa dvādasakena hoti, dvādas'āhaṃ ekato nivāsena hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: mitto have sattapadena hoti, sahāyo pana dvādasakena hoti, mās'aḍḍhamāsena ca ñāti hoti, tat'uttariṃ attasamo'pi hoti, so'haṃ kathaṃ attasukhassa hetu, cirasanthutaṃ kāḷakaṇṇiṃ jaheyyan'ti.

34329.commentary: (VINa) dvādasapuriso hatthī'ti cattāro ārohakā ek'ekapādarakkhakā dve dve'ti evaṃ dvādasapuriso hoti.

examples.text: senā nāma hatthī assā rathā pattī. dvādasapuriso hatthī, tipuriso asso, catupuriso ratho, cattāro purisā sarahatthā patti. dassanāya gacchati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

34330.meaning1: measuring the height of twelve men; twelve fathoms in measure
34330.meaning2: measuring the height of twelve men

examples.text: ek'ekasmiṃ dvāre satta satta esikā nikhātā ahesuṃ tiporis'aṅgā tiporisanikhātā dvādasaporisā ubbedhena.
iti h'etaṃ vijānāma, ekādasamo so parābhavo, dvādasamaṃ bhagavā brūhi, kiṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

yaṃ kho pana, rājañña, mānussakaṃ vassasataṃ, devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ eso eko rattin'divo, tāya rattiyā tiṃsarattiyo māso, tena māsena dvādasamāsiyo saṃvaccharo, tena saṃvaccharena dibbaṃ vassasahassaṃ devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.

34336.meaning2: extending twelve yojanas; approximately two hundred and forty kilometres in extent

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, rājañña, aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa dve pajāpatiyo ahesuṃ. ekissā putto ahosi dasavass'uddesiko vā dvādasavass'uddesiko vā, ekā gabbhinī upavijaññā.

idha, mahārāja, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hotī'ti ettha santuṭṭho'ti itar'ītarapaccayasantosena samannāgato. so pan'esa santoso dvādasavidho hoti, seyyath'idaṃ, cīvare yathālābhasantoso, yathābalasantoso, yathāsāruppasantoso'ti tividho. evaṃ piṇḍapāt'ādīsu.

34341.commentary: (SNa) dvādas'ākāran'ti tesaṃ'y'eva ek'ekasmiṃ sacce tiṇṇaṃ tiṇṇaṃ ākārānaṃ vasena dvādas'ākāraṃ.

examples.text: yāvakīvañ'ca me, bhikkhave, imesu catūsu ariyasaccesu evan'tiparivaṭṭaṃ dvādas'ākāraṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ na suvisuddhaṃ ahosi,

34342.meaning1: dependent on the twelve unwholesome actions

examples.text: ekamūlaṃ dvi'r'āvaṭṭaṃ, timalaṃ pañcapattharaṃ, samuddaṃ dvādas'āvaṭṭaṃ, pātālaṃ atarī isī'ti.

34344.meaning2: twelfth day of the lunar fortnight

examples.text: apārutā tesaṃ amatassa dvārā, ye sotavanto pamuñcantu saddhaṃ, vihiṃsasaññī paguṇaṃ na bhāsiṃ, dhammaṃ paṇītaṃ manujesu brahme'ti.
hoti kho so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena tassa mahānirayassa puratthimaṃ dvāraṃ apāpurīyati.

34349.meaning2: door of action; i.e. body, speech or mind

34350.meaning2: shutter of a door, doors and windows

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā bahidvārakoṭṭhakā nikkhāmetvā sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami
mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena yāva dvārakosā aggaḷaṭṭhapanāya ālokasandhiparikammāya dvatticchadanassa pariyāyaṃ appaharite ṭhitena adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ

34356.meaning1: fixing the door; setting the door in place; supporting the door
34356.meaningLit: causing the standing of the door

examples.text: aggaḷaṭṭhapanāyā'ti dvāraṭṭhapanāya.

34358.commentary: (APAa) dvārapālo ca saṃvaro'ti te tuyhaṃ chadvārikasaṃvaro rakkh'āvaraṇagutti dvārapālo dvārarakkhako'ti attho.

examples.text: yathā, mahārāja, puriso rañño cakkavattissa madhuṃ vā madhupiṇḍikaṃ vā aññaṃ vā upāyanaṃ abhihareyya, tam'enaṃ rañño dvārapālo evaṃ vadeyya akālo, bho, ayaṃ rañño dassanāya, tena hi, bho, tava upāyanaṃ gahetvā sīghasīghaṃ paṭinivatta, pure tava rājā daṇḍaṃ dhāressatī'ti.
sīlaṃ pākārakaṃ tattha, ñāṇaṃ te dvārakoṭṭhakaṃ, saddhā te esikā vīra, dvārapālo ca saṃvaro.
upasaṅkamitvā mahāviyūhassa kūṭ'āgārassa dvārabāhaṃ ālambitvā aṭṭhāsi.
tirokuṭṭesu tiṭṭhanti, sandhisiṅghāṭakesu ca, dvārabāhāsu tiṭṭhanti, āgantvāna sakaṃ gharaṃ.

34361.meaning1: food placed in front of the door
34361.commentary: (SNPa) dvārabhattaṃ upaṭṭhitan'ti brāhmaṇānaṃ dassāmā'ti sajjetvā tehi tehi dāyakehi attano attano gharadvāre ṭhapitabhattaṃ.

examples.text: yaṃ nesaṃ pakataṃ āsi, dvārabhattaṃ upaṭṭhitaṃ, saddhāpakatam'esānaṃ, dātave tadamaññisuṃ.

34362.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: bodhi mahānāmo atho'pi uttaro, kesī sikhī sundaro dvārabhājo, tiss'ūpatissā bhavabandhanacchidā, upasikhi taṇhacchido ca sikhari.
nānākulassa māḷo hoti nānāgabbhā nānā-ovarakā, yasmiṃ gabbhe cīvaraṃ nikkhittaṃ hoti tasmiṃ gabbhe vatthabbaṃ dvāramūle vā, hatthapāsā vā na vijahitabbaṃ.

34364.commentary: (MNa) majjhimāya dvārasālāyān'ti yassa gharassa satta dvārakoṭṭhakā, tassa sabb'ābbhantarato vā sabbabāhirato vā paṭṭhāya catutthadvārakoṭṭhako, yassa pañca, tassa tatiyo, yassa tayo, tassa dutiyo dvārakoṭṭhako majjhimadvārasālā nāma.

examples.text: atha kho upāli gahapati yena majjhimā dvārasālā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā yaṃ tattha āsanaṃ aggañ'ca seṭṭhañ'ca uttamañ'ca paṇītañ'ca tattha sāmaṃ nisīditvā dovārikaṃ āmantesi

34365.meaning1: door and window; doors and windows

34368.meaning1: ascetic who subsists on only two mouthfuls of food
34368.commentary: (DNa) ek'ālopiko'ti yo eken'eva ālopena yāpeti. dv'āgārik'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: te ek'āgārikā vā honti ek'ālopikā, dv'āgārikā vā honti dv'ālopikā… satt'āgārikā vā honti satt'ālopikā. ekissā'pi dattiyā yāpenti, dvīhi'pi dattīhi yāpenti… sattahi'pi dattīhi yāpenti.

imehi kho te, bhikkhave, samaṇabrāhmaṇā pubb'antakappikā ca apar'antakappikā ca pubb'ant'āpar'antakappikā ca pubb'ant'āpar'ant'ānudiṭṭhino pubb'ant'āpar'antaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhimuttipadāni abhivadanti dvāsaṭṭhiyā vatthūhi.

34370.commentary: (ANt) micchā passati tāya, sayaṃ vā micchā passati, micchādassanam'eva vā tan'ti micchādiṭṭhi, yaṃ kiñci viparītadassanaṃ. ten'āha, dvāsaṭṭhividhāyā'ti-ādi.

examples.text: dutiye micchādiṭṭhī'ti dvāsaṭṭhividhāya'pi micchādiṭṭhiyā etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. micchādiṭṭhikassā'ti tāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgatassa.

34371.commentary: (SNa) tass'attho, bho gotama, mayaṃ dvāsattati janā puññakammā tena puññakammena idha nibbattā.

examples.text: dvāsattati gotama puññakammā, vasavattino jātijaraṃ atītā, ayam'antimā vedagū brahm'upapatti, asm'ābhijappanti janā anekā'ti.
dv'āhaṃ sakkaṃ apucchissaṃ, na me byākāsi cakkhumā, yāvatatiyañ'ca dev'īsi, byākarotī'ti me sutaṃ.

34378.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of dvāhika
34378.meaning1: every two days; (comm) with two days in-between
34378.construction:
dvi + aha + ika + aṃ
dvāhika + aṃ
34378.commentary: (DNt) apica ek'āhaṃ abhuñjitvā ek'āhaṃ bhuñjanaṃ, ek'āhavāro vā ek'āhikaṃ. dvī'haṃ abhuñjitvā dvī'haṃ bhuñjanaṃ, dvī'havāro vā dv'āhikaṃ.

examples.text: ek'āhikam'pi āhāraṃ āhāreti, dv'āhikaṃ'pi āhāraṃ āhāreti, satt'āhikam'pi āhāraṃ āhāreti, iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikam'pi pariyāya-bhatta-bhojan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.
dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ pasavati

puthulato pana diyaḍḍharatanaṃ dvīsu passesu ratanamatt'ānucaṅkamaṃ dīghato saṭṭhihatthaṃ mudutalaṃ sama-vippakiṇṇa-vālukaṃ caṅkamaṃ vaṭṭati cetiyagirimhi dīpappasādaka-mahindattherassa caṅkamanaṃ viya, tādisaṃ taṃ ahosi.
nī pāpuṇane, dvikammako'yaṃ, ajaṃ gāmaṃ neti, nenti.

34382.meaning1: with two huts; with two houses
34382.commentary: (VINa) tattha yasmiṃ gāme ekā eva kuṭi, ekaṃ gehaṃ seyyathā'pi malayajanapade, ayaṃ ekakuṭiko gāmo nāma. etena nayena apare'pi veditabbā.

examples.text: gāmo nāma ekakuṭiko'pi gāmo, dvikuṭiko'pi gāmo, tikuṭiko'pi gāmo, catukuṭiko'pi gāmo, samanusso'pi gāmo, amanusso'pi gāmo, parikkhitto'pi gāmo, aparikkhitto'pi gāmo, gonisādiniviṭṭho'pi gāmo, yo'pi sattho atirekacatumāsaniviṭṭho so'pi vuccati gāmo.
catukkhattuṃ codetvā catukkhattuṃ ṭhātabbaṃ. pañcakkhatuṃ codetvā dvikkhattuṃ ṭhātabbaṃ. chakkhattuṃ codetvā na ṭhātabbaṃ.

34387.meaning1: two-eyed; clear sighted; with material and spiritual vision
34387.commentary: (MNt) paññācakkhunā diṭṭhadhammikassa samparāyikassa ca atthassa adassanato andho, diṭṭhadhammikass'eva dassanato ekacakkhu, dvinnam'pi dassanato dvicakkhu, veditabbo.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo dvicakkhu? idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa tathārūpaṃ cakkhu hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā anadhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ adhigaccheyya, adhigataṃ vā bhogaṃ phātiṃ kareyya, tathārūpam'pi'ssa cakkhu hoti yathārūpena cakkhunā kusal'ākusale dhamme jāneyya, sāvajj'ānavajje dhamme jāneyya, hīnappaṇīte dhamme jāneyya, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāge dhamme jāneyya.

34389.meaning2: which moves with eight constituent parts; which leads those with eight characteristics (?)

34391.meaning1: twice born; born from an egg; oviparous

examples.text: ekajaṃ vā dvijaṃ vā'pi, yo'dha pāṇaṃ vihiṃsati, yassa pāṇe dayā n'atthi, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

34398.meaning1: two palm trees in height; two palm trees deep

examples.text: hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ mahāsamudde sattatālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, chattālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, pañcatālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, catuttālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, titālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, dvitālam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, tālamattam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti.
